what: Behind large list rows such as Service, four rounded-square photo plates stand in a faded (.6) line on the right, tilted 8°, and when a row is hovered the plate line slides in over 1s power2.out to that row’s slot (horizontal 0·−28·−56·−84% · vertical 0·−40·−80·−120px) and only that plate stands up at −7° and 1.3x (.8s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)). Other rows fade to .3 (.2s), and on release the plate lies down and the rows darken, but the plate line stays in place. Below 993px the plates are hidden

options.x: Horizontal position of each line’s panel (%, space-separated), default ‹0 -28 -56 -84›
options.y: Vertical position (px) of each panel row, default ”0 -40 -80 -120”
options.min: Minimum window width to light up (px), default 993
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel stage (panel covering behind the row) — contains reel
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Panel (same order as the row) — slot for photo or video inside

from.where: index.html service list (original .listing__item hover — .listing__bg-list xPercent [0,−28,−56,−84] · y [0,−40,−80,−120] 1s power2.out, .listing__bg-item.active rotate(−7°) scale(1.3) .8s, other rows opacity .3)
